title: Qt: Manually connect our "Analyze" menu actions.

notes.body:
added 4 commits
  • 91eaa46c...3b7df80a - 3 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • 647978b8 - Qt: Manually connect our "Analyze" menu actions.
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/8996/diffs?diff_id=548811510&start_sha=91eaa46ce2ad58be2db13047f78aa6b120d051dd)

I haven't done anything to confirm that its related to this change, but since rebuilding today, I am finding that right-click |  'Add as Column..' is missing from the popup menu, and I'm seeing console output like:

** (wireshark:97913) 11:24:47.014649 [GUI WARNING] -- QWidget::insertAction: Attempt to insert null action

This is with Qt 5.15.2 on Ubuntu linux.

changes_data.diff:

     <addaction name="actionAnalyzeDisplayFilterMacros"/>
     <addaction name="actionDisplayFilterExpression"/>
     <addaction name="separator"/>
-    <addaction name="actionAnalyzeCreateAColumn"/>
+    <addaction name="actionAnalyzeApplyAsColumn"/>
     <addaction name="menuApplyAsFilter"/>
     <addaction name="menuPrepareAFilter"/>
     <addaction name="menuConversationFilter"/>
@@ -1186,7 +1186,7 @@
     <string>Display Filter &Macros…</string>
    </property>
   </action>
-  <action name="actionAnalyzeCreateAColumn">
+  <action name="actionAnalyzeApplyAsColumn">
    <property name="text">
     <string>Apply as Column</string>
    </property>

@@ -435,7 +435,7 @@
     <addaction name="actionAnalyzeDisplayFilterMacros"/>

     <addaction name="separator"/>

@@ -1418,7 +1418,7 @@

    </property>
   </action>
-  <action name="actionAnalyzeCreateAColumn">
+  <action name="actionAnalyzeApplyAsColumn">
    <property name="text">
     <string>Apply as Column</string>
    </property>
